params.caption: 🖥️ Nvidia posts record $115.8 billion quarter Nvidia's quarterly revenue jumped to $115.8 billion, another record, with its new Vera Rubin platform bringing in $20 billion in its debut quarter. Total commitments to suppliers and customers have climbed to $540 billion, and rising costs have led the company to revise its pricing strategy for fiscal 2028. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 16:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 👥 @nvidia 📈 Will this keep GPU prices high?
